mcq: Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a library that is accessible by the public, funded by the government using public funds (such as taxes) and operated by civil servants."
The Definition of Public Libraries A public library is a library that is accessible by the public, funded by the government using public funds (such as taxes) and operated by civil servants.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ are the clerks, accountants, librarians, and you."
The end-users or clients are the clerks, accountants, librarians, and you.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ are the combination of the faculty, computing professionals, course designers, and web experts."
Resource-based learning teams are the combination of the faculty, computing professionals, course designers, and web experts.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a collection of hardware, software, and people working together to collect, store, sort, and process information."
Information System (IS) An information system is a collection of hardware, software, and people working together to collect, store, sort, and process information.

Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is an institution that cares for (conserves) a collection of artifacts and other objects of artistic, cultural, historical, or scientific importance."
A museum is an institution that cares for (conserves) a collection of artifacts and other objects of artistic, cultural, historical, or scientific importance.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a collection of sources of information made accessible to a defined community for reference or borrowing."
A library is a collection of sources of information made accessible to a defined community for reference or borrowing.
fib: ______ is an integral part of the formal education system which provides time-bound education from primary school level to university level.
The academic library is an integral part of the formal education system which provides time-bound education from primary school level to university level.
______ is a library attached to a university.
University Library A university library is a library attached to a university.
______ is a library within a school where students, staff, and often, parents of a public or private school have access to a variety of resources.
School Library A school library is a library within a school where students, staff, and often, parents of a public or private school have access to a variety of resources.
______ is a valuable resource, but it is not possible for an ordinary teacher to alter it.
The database of information is a valuable resource, but it is not possible for an ordinary teacher to alter it.

Virtual libraries are the new vision of libraries of the future.
